result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example comes out as Anna 2, Bob 1.

- **Fix:** `DataStore.countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 6514) now adds `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to its count, the same filter the quarterly and latest-purchase-order reports use. I also updated its Javadoc to say so.
- **Test:** added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` to `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`, built on your example, plus a small overload of the test helper that takes a status.
- **Verification:** `mvn -q -o test -Dtest=SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes with no output. I did not run the test against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there.

Nothing is committed.
